name: go2-mapper
description: Map your home with the Go2's Mid-360 LiDAR and export G1-ready navigation maps (3D .pcd + 2D Nav2 grid + waypoints). Live Foxglove view + web console with downloads.

variables.name: NETWORK_INTERFACE
variables.description: Host NIC on the 192.168.123.0/24 dog subnet. On the Go2's onboard Orin this is often 'enP8p1s0' (verified on a JP6.1 unit), NOT 'eth0'. Check with `ip -o addr` on the device; the right NIC is the one with a 192.168.123.x address.
variables.prompt: Host network interface (Orin is usually enP8p1s0)

variables.name: LIDAR_SOURCE
variables.description: Which LiDAR to map with: 'mid360' (stock Unitree Mid-360, xyz-only cloud via shim) or 'hesai' (aftermarket Hesai XT-16 with real ring+time, native Point-LIO path). 'hesai' also builds the Hesai driver.

variables.name: LIDAR_TOPIC
variables.description: Deskewed Mid-360 cloud from Unitree's driver (used when LIDAR_SOURCE=mid360)

variables.name: IMU_TOPIC
variables.description: IMU topic Point-LIO fuses (the Go2's /utlidar/imu for both LiDAR sources; the XT-16 has no IMU of its own)

variables.name: GO2_HESAI_IP
variables.description: Hesai XT-16 sensor IP on the dog subnet (used when LIDAR_SOURCE=hesai)

variables.name: GO2_HESAI_HOST
variables.description: Host NIC IP on the dog subnet the Hesai sends to (the Orin's 192.168.123.x address)

variables.name: SLICE_MIN_M
variables.description: Lower bound (m above floor) of the 2D obstacle slice — tuned for the G1's body, not the Go2's

variables.name: SLICE_MAX_M
variables.description: Upper bound (m above floor) of the 2D obstacle slice (G1 head height + margin)

variables.name: GRID_RESOLUTION_M
variables.description: Nav2 occupancy grid cell size in meters

variables.name: LIDAR_HEIGHT_OFFSET_M
variables.description: Mid-360 mount height above floor on the Go2 (used as a floor-fit prior; final z=0 comes from RANSAC)
